papers.title: Turtle farm note
lines: The green turtles were hunted for centuries by sailors who named the islands after them.
Now they swim in tanks and out to sea, in a plan nobody expected to work and is working.

papers.title: Dive-boat log
lines: Stingray City: waist-deep water, a sandbar, a hundred friendly rays like wet velvet pancakes.
They know the sound of the boat engine. They are waiting. They want squid.

papers.title: Letter from a cousin in Grand Cayman
lines: Dear Mam, the sun here is the same sun as at home, but louder. I work in an office with air conditioning.
The sea is warm and the beer is cold. I miss the rain, a little. Do not tell anyone.

papers.title: Postcard from Grand Cayman
lines: Greetings from a pirate island. Nobody here is a pirate any more. They are mostly accountants.
The rum is still excellent. I brought you a bottle, which I drank on the flight.
